#651 · Spiny Armor Pokémon

Quilladin

Grass

Kalos · Generation 6

Quilladin is a Grass-type Spiny Armor Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 29 kg. It evolves from Chespin and into Chesnaught. Its highest base stat is Defense (95), with a base stat total of 405.
